channel.title: James H. Nguyen's Blog
channel.description: Technical articles on cloud architecture, platform engineering, AI agents, and DevOps.

item.title: Hybrid Project-Scoped AI Bots with OpenClaw
item.description: Why role-based bots lose context across projects — and how adding project-scoped bots with pre-seeded workspaces gives each AI assistant deep, persistent knowledge of exactly what it's working on.

item.title: Making It Stick — Teaching Your AI Workflow to Self-Organize
item.description: How three files — AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, and the orchestrate skill — turned a team of idle agents into a self-routing engineering org.

item.title: Agentic Coding: Why the Next Productivity Leap Is About Collaboration, Not Autocomplete
item.description: Agentic coding reframes software development around collaborative, tool-using AI agents. Learn what it is, how it works, and how to adopt it safely.

item.title: The Orchestration Skill — Automating the Workflow
item.description: Task boards, quality gates, and cron-driven automation. How we stopped managing the AI team and became the client.

item.title: Giving Each Agent a Desk — Persistent Identities
item.description: How we went from ephemeral sub-agents to a permanent AI engineering team with identity, memory, and channel routing.

item.title: The Lead Agent — Teaching Your AI to Delegate
item.description: How we went from a single AI assistant to a 5-agent engineering org — and what broke along the way.

item.title: Airline IT Stack: Why It’s Stuck (and How It Actually Works)
item.description: A detailed technical breakdown of the airline IT stack (GDS, PSS, direct channels), how components interact, and why modernization stalls.

item.title: Building OpenClaw: An AI Agent That Lives on Your Devices
item.description: An introduction to OpenClaw - a personal AI assistant that runs 24/7 across your Mac, Android, and cloud infrastructure. Learn about the architecture, capabilities, and vision behind this open-source project.
